shots.content: Inside a seminar room, a rectangular worktable stands between a pinboard and the entrance, with windows along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A man in a red shirt sits at the pinboard-side window seat, arguing about accomplishment, while a man in a green shirt sits at the entrance-side window seat and a woman in an orange shirt sits at the pinboard-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the entrance end, looking along the worktable toward the pinboard, with both window-side seats and the pinboard-end seat and the pinboard in frame.

shots.content: A man in a green shirt leaves his seat and exits the venue, while a man in a red shirt asks what standard defines mastery.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A man in a red shirt questions whether attaining such a standard is possible.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the worktable.
